name: Gisborne Giants
description: The Gisborne Giants won their first Superstock Teams title in 10 years since reforming, taking the ENZED championship at RPIS in February 2026.

name: Canterbury Crushers
description: The Canterbury Crushers took the NZ Stockcar Teams title south, winning at Rotorua in March 2026 and denying the Rascals a rare three-peat.

name: Rotorua Rascals
description: The Rotorua Rascals are back-to-back NZ Stockcar Teams Champions (2024, 2025). Fell short of a three-peat at home in March 2026.

name: Canterbury Glen Eagles
description: The Canterbury Glen Eagles achieved a historic hat-trick at the Superstock Teams Extravaganza at RPIS in December 2025.

name: Baypark Busters
description: Baypark's Superstock Teams entry, based at Baypark Speedway in Tauranga.

name: Stratford Stormers
description: Taranaki's Superstock Teams contenders from Stratford Speedway.

name: Whanganui Vulcans
description: Whanganui's Superstock team from Oceanview Speedway.

name: Waikato Raiders
description: Waikato's Superstock Teams entry based at Huntly International Speedway.

name: Kihikihi Kings
description: Kihikihi's Superstock Teams contenders from McDonald's Kihikihi Speedway.

name: Palmerston North Pumas
